FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (FIR)
Case No: FIR/2026/BLR/0847
Police Station: Koramangala PS, Bengaluru City

Date of Incident: 14 August 2026
Time of Incident: Approximately 22:30 hours

Complainant: Priya Sharma, aged 32 years, residing at 45 MG Road, Bengaluru

DETAILS OF INCIDENT:

The complainant Priya Sharma reported that on 14 August 2026 at approximately 22:30 hours, she was returning home from her workplace at Infosys Technologies Limited when she noticed two individuals on a motorcycle bearing registration number KA 01 AB 1234 following her near the Koramangala 4th Block junction.

The first individual was later identified as Ravi Kumar, male, approximately 28 years of age, known to frequent the Madiwala market area. The second individual on the motorcycle was identified as Suresh Rao, male, approximately 25 years of age.

The complainant further stated that the accused snatched her handbag containing a mobile phone (contact number 9876543210), cash of Rs. 15,000, and identity documents. The accused fled towards the Ejipura flyover.

Witnesses: Mr. Venkatesh Murthy, shopkeeper at nearby establishment, contact number 8765432109, confirmed seeing the motorcycle with registration KA 01 AB 1234 speeding away from the scene.

Investigating Officer: Inspector Deepak Patil, Koramangala PS
FIR registered under sections 356 and 379 IPC.

Location of Incident: Koramangala 4th Block Junction, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
GPS Coordinates: 12.9352, 77.6245
